title: Dependency map mapping
description: Services, instances, owners, migration waves, HA groups, external endpoints, Kubernetes workloads and estate places for the Dependency map panel.

match.description: IP addresses and CIDRs in the place.

note.description: Shown under the name, e.g. "HAProxy + keepalived".

preset.description: Storage only: names Ceph's port roles (mon on 3300 and 6789, OSD / mgr on 6800-7300).

forwardsTo.description: Load balancers only: clusters or places it forwards to; drawn dashed as "not measured" when no such flow is measured.

places.description: Places on the estate view. Leaving out internet uses well-known public ranges; internet: [] turns them off.

name.description: Shown on the map; defaults to id.

wave.description: 0 = stays in the old data centre, 1..n = migration wave.

minUp.description: active-active: instances that must be up. Default 1.

load.description: Load as % of the capacity of all instances together.

loadQuery.description: PromQL returning the load as % of the capacity of all instances.

vip.description: Virtual IP clients should call. Calls to an instance IP are hard-wired to that instance.

match.description: An IP, a CIDR, or a name reported by the collector.

kubernetes.description: Optional (added in v0.2.0). Clusters and the services made of their pods. Pods are matched by cluster, namespace and workload, never by address.

name.description: As OBI reports it in k8s_cluster_name (OTEL_EBPF_KUBE_CLUSTER_NAME).

egressIps.description: Addresses pod traffic leaves the cluster with, when not the node addresses (egress gateway, NAT).

hideNamespaces.description: Namespaces left off the map. Default ["kube-system"].

name.description: Node name as the Kubernetes API reports it.

ip.description: The address other networks see; the source of SNATed pod traffic, used in firewall rules.

addresses.description: Other addresses of the node: recognised, not used in rules.

name.description: Shown on the map; defaults to id.

cluster.description: Required when more than one cluster is listed.

workload.description: Workload (top owner) name, or a glob with *. Default: the id.

services.description: Kubernetes Service names in front of it. Default: the workload name, when it is not a glob.

replicas.description: Desired replicas; HA is judged against these.

ha.description: Default active-active when replicas > 1, else single.

minUp.description: active-active: instances that must be up. Default 1.

load.description: Load as % of the capacity of all instances together.

loadQuery.description: PromQL returning the load as % of the capacity of all instances.
